items.titleJa: 16万スター超のCLAUDE.mdに学ぶ、Claude Codeを暴走させない運用術
items.summaryJa: CLAUDE.md を活用して Claude Code の振る舞いを制御することが、長時間の安定運用と安全性向上に不可欠だと説明されている。 Andrej Karpathy の four原則（Think Before Coding、Simplicity First、Surgical Changes、Goal-Driven Execution）を中心に、具体的な運用方針とグローバル/プロジェクト別の配置、および実務での注意点が紹介されている。 CLAUDE.md は永続的な指示として読み込まれるが強制設定ではなく、必要に応じてプロンプト側の制約と併用して運用するのが現実的とされている。

items.summaryJa: Claude Lemieux, 60, a 21-season NHL veteran and four-time Stanley Cup champion, died Thursday, with Canadiens announcing his passing. He won Cups with Montreal (1986), New Jersey (1995, 2000) and Colorado (1996), and earned the 1995 Conn Smythe Trophy as playoff MVP after scoring 13 goals in 20 postseason games. His career included 234 playoff games (sixth in NHL history) and 80 playoff goals (ninth), and he was known as a clutch but controversial player who later worked as a player agent.

items.title: Team-wide provider allowlist on AI Gateway
items.summary: AI Gateway now supports a team-wide provider allowlist. Teams can restrict which providers can serve requests, so traffic only routes to approved providers. The allowlist applies to every request through AI Gateway, including Bring Your Own Key (BYOK) traffic. Regulated teams typically vet AI providers across multiple dimensions with security and legal sign-off, ending up with a vendor set that reflects the specific requirements of their org. The allowlist turns that approved-vendor list into a routing guarantee: Enforcement happens at the gateway level, not at the request level. A developer on the team cannot route traffic to a provider the org hasn't approved. This restriction also applies to coding agents. Even if an agent omits or modifies request-level provider filters, AI Gateway still blocks unapproved providers. Only team owners can modify the provider allowlist, keeping control centralized and auditable. New providers are disabled by default once the allowlist is on, so the approved set doesn't silently expand when AI Gateway integrates a new vendor. How to configure Toggle on Provider Allowlist in the AI Gateway Settings tab. All current providers are allowed by default, so existing traffic is unaffected. Disable any providers your team shouldn't use. The allowlist filters by provider, not by model. AI Gateway falls back to other allowed providers for the same model if the initial provider fails. The allowlist also functions as an and with other restrictions applied to the team, like Zero Data Retention (ZDR) or request-level filtering. For example, if a team has disabled DeepSeek in their allowlist and a request pins routing to only the DeepSeek provider: Since DeepSeek is not in the allowlist, AI Gateway rejects the request. Provider Allowlist works across every API format supported by AI Gateway, including AI SDK, OpenAI Chat Completions API, and Anthropic Messages API. Read the provider allowlist documentation for more information. items.titleJa: AppleのHuman Interface Guidelinesから学ぶ、美しいWeb/UIデザインの作り方
items.summaryJa: AppleのHIGを基に、Web/UIデザインは装飾よりも「見せ方の理解しやすさ」が美しさを生むと整理しています。情報の階層を明確にし、コンテンツを主役にして、階層・色・タイポグラフィ・ボタンの押せる見せ方・フィードバック・モーション・アクセシビリティを組み合わせることで、見やすく使いやすいUIになると説明します。最後に、デザインの判断基準として「分かりやすさを高めるにはどうするか」を常に優先することを強調しています。

items.title: Firecrawl joins the Vercel Marketplace
items.summary: Firecrawl is now available on the Vercel Marketplace , allowing Vercel teams to power AI agents and applications with structured web data without managing crawling infrastructure. Key capabilities include: Scrape pages into markdown, HTML, structured data, or screenshots Search the web and retrieve full page content in a single call Interact with dynamic websites using AI prompts or code Get started with Firecrawl on the Vercel Marketplace. items.title: Microfrontends routing now applies to vc alias and branch domains
items.summary: This week we are gradually rolling out an update to Vercel Microfrontends routing for aliases and branch-assigned domains. Aliases inherit Microfrontends routing Aliasing a Microfrontends URL with vc alias now preserves the full microfrontends routing config from the source deployment. Previously, the new alias only inherited the deploymentId . Update to the latest Vercel CLI to pick up the change. Branch domains route across all projects A project domain assigned to a git branch now routes to that branch in every project in the Microfrontend that shares the branch name. Previously, the domain only routed to that branch within the project that owned the domain. See the Microfrontends documentation for details on routing, aliases, and domain assignment. Read more
items.titleJa: マイクロフロントエンドのルーティングが VC エイリアスとブランチ ドメインに適用されるようになりました

items.title: Cross-Document View Transitions: Scaling Across Hundreds of Elements
items.summary: Every view-transition-name on a page must be unique. The problem is that every pseudo-element selector in your CSS targets a specific name, so your animation styles explode into an unmanageable wall of selectors. Cross-Document View Transitions: Scaling Across Hundreds of Elements originally handwritten and published with love on CSS-Tricks . You should really get the newsletter as well.
items.titleJa: ドキュメント間のビュー遷移: 数百の要素にわたるスケーリング
items.summaryJa: 大規模なビュー・トランジションを実現するには、CSSだけで自動的に一意の識別子を生成するアイデアが鍵となる。現状は ident() が未実装で使えないため、代替として Names（view-transition-name）と Classes（view-transition-class）の使い分けを徹底する方法が提案されている。具体的には、各アイテムに固有の名前を付けつつ、クラスで共通のアニメーション定義を適用することで、何千件でも一つのスタイルシートで管理可能にするという方針である。

items.titleJa: フロントエンドもアーキテクチャに向き合う！
items.summaryJa: 社内システムのフロントエンドを、ドメインごとに責務を分けた段階的なアーキテクチャ移行を行った経緯をまとめた。フェーズ1で features/{domain} と repository を導入して、外部依存をドメイン層から切り離しテスト性を高め、フェーズ2で domains と models を分離してルールと UI 表現を分離。フェーズ3で infrastructure を導入しライブラリ依存を共通化、呼び出し側の実装を隠蔽。フェーズ4で core を導入し、複数文脈で共有される最内側の概念を src/core に集約して型変換を一本化した。結果、ビジネスロジックと UI 依存が分離され、テストしやすさと変更容易性が向上した。
